notes.sowing: Sow {cm:1.3} deep from 3 weeks before your last frost, or start indoors 4 to 6 weeks ahead. A week of nights below {c:10} can make young plants bolt later, so do not set them out too early.
notes.care: Keep growth fast and even with steady watering; drought and heat make the swollen stems tough and woody. For a fall crop, sow about 10 weeks before your first fall frost.
notes.harvest: Harvest when the swollen stem is {cm:5} to {cm:7.5} across. Larger stems turn woody, though fall crops can be left a little bigger.
